note: Page-level components of a parsed web page (web-to-figma). Not drawn in the kit: found on the page, built from the kit's atoms. Same atomic levels as the kit.

components.name: Header
components.holds: instances of Navigation, Menu, Button, Icon button, Search bar
components.proof: header tag or block named header

components.name: Footer
components.holds: instances of Link, Text group, Icon
components.proof: footer tag or block named footer

components.name: Navigation
components.proof: nav tag, or block named nav; top one = Navigation, others Subnav

components.name: Menu
components.holds: instances of Menu item (kit Dropdown Menu Item)
components.proof: role menu or menubar, or 4+ leaves in a block named submenu, dropdown or megamenu

components.name: Card
components.holds: instances of Image, Badge, Button, Icon, Text
components.proof: kit Card proof (vertical, painted and rounded, or image first and repeated)

components.name: Section heading
components.when: only when repeated (one family, whatever its parts: kicker, text, buttons are options)
components.proof: unpainted block of 2-6 leaves, texts and buttons only, holding an h1-h6
